english.title: Fail to give notice to a registrable person / relevant legal entity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were

(A)_[a company to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and which]_
(B)_[an officer, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..) of a company to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..) and who was in default in that the company]_

failed to give notice to a person or entity whom it knew or had reasonable cause to believe to be a registrable person or a registrable relevant legal entity in relation to it
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 790D(2) and 790F of the Companies Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) This offence is no longer in force from 18/11/2025. Section 790D was substituted for new sections 790CB, 790D, 790DA, 790E, 790EA, 790EB and 790EC by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 from 18/11/2025. This introduced a new statutory scheme for the company duties in relation to registerable people and legal entities. Failure to perform the duties contained within the legislation are offences under section 790F.
(ii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
